## Scientific accuracy warning

- **Illustrative AI-generated artwork:** molecular ball-and-stick structures, atom counts, surface bonding geometry, reaction arrows and especially the vinyl/ethylidene alternate-path labels should be **checked against primary literature** before scientific reuse. Some graphic labels/depictions may be internally inconsistent. Do not treat either raster image as a trustworthy elementary mechanism.
- **The figures' tier/status labels are historical and now outdated.** Current personal map has Tier3 Our Reactions = Informal Writing; Tier4 Microscopic Reaction Pathways = AI worked out. Tier5 Adsorption stage should be read from `current_map.yaml`, not from a static picture.
- **Model sources:** Urmès et al. (2019) Table 3 DOI `10.3390/catal9020180` applies to supported Pd/α-Al₂O₃, Mei et al. (2009) DOI `10.1016/j.jcat.2009.09.004` is idealized Pd/PdAg KMC with abstract/preview-level support in the existing AI ledger. Neither validates specific BEP PdAg mechanisms, saturation values, or periodic yield gain.
